title: scenarios travel_expense: file_and_submit_from_text pins the claim lines' quantity shape (2 x 430, 3 x 115) — check the per-type amounts instead, so per-unit lines also pass
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6963882491), from area o3-H's reading on #34998 (6963855363).

## What happens
`docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json`, operation `file_and_submit_from_text`, pins the line shape `claim_line quantity 2 × 430` and `quantity 3 × 115`.

On main, the agent filed per-night and per-day lines at quantity 1. That is an equally faithful reading, with `total_amount` = 1205, matching the card. It is graded as a fail.

## Done when
- The operation checks the per-type amounts (hotel 860, meals 345), or accepts either line shape.
- The scorecard notes the card change.

Parent: #34659. Blocks: #34996 ("operations 100%").
Grade: **p1 · domain:devx · area:ai**. It falsely fails a correct answer and caps the maintainer-requested loop.
